candidates.statement: b) Each individual Post-Marketing Surveillance/Clinical study Plan related to the additional pharmacovigilance activities should be described in items in the Annex. As a general rule, the submitter should file them one month before the timing of planned product market launch.
candidates.context: ii) In the case of products which a draft of Risk Management Plan is submitted by the MAHs due to above 2-b) at the time of new drug application, the fixed document of Risk management Plan with reference data should be submitted one month before the timing of planned product market launch as a general rule instead of the specific methods and plans of post-marketing surveillance and risk management. c) Submission methods : a submitter may directly bring or mail the fixed document of the Risk Management Plan or the Post-Marketing Surveillance/Clinical study Plan to the Office of review administration, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency.

candidates.statement: d) A submitter should file an original and two copies of the fixed document of Risk Management Plan or Post-Marketing Surveillance/Clinical study Plan.

candidates.statement: 5. Others a) When the MAHs change Risk Management Plan including the case of above 4, except for the minor change, the Risk Management Plan should be submitted to the PMDA. In addition, the author should underline the changed parts and put down with the latest contents.
candidates.context: When new safety concerns have been identified in the post-marketing phase and the MAHs might want to develop or change Risk Management Plan, contact the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) regarding the timing of submission and the content of the plan. b) The MHLW will issue notification regarding the form of periodic reports based on the implementation of Risk Management Plan later.

candidates.statement: 1. General  The text should be laid out for Japanese Industrial standards A4 paper.
candidates.context: Guide for developing Risk Management Plan  A submitter may attach a separate sheet with describing as ”the attached document” in the column if all of the statement cannot describe within each column.

candidates.statement:  If a submitter files a draft of Risk Management Plan as part of applications for new drugs, biosimilars/follow on biologics, generics and partial changes, it is recommended that the document should be submitted along with outline of the draft of Post-Marketing Surveillance/Clinical study Plan and the draft of the materials of Risk minimization plan at the time.
candidates.context:  For every particular items in the plan, if there is no statement to be included in the column, the author may put N/A in the space.  If a submitter files a draft of Risk Management Plan other than a point of drug application, the draft of Post-Marketing Surveillance/Clinical study Plan and materials for additional phamacovigilance activities and additional risk minimization activities should be submitted at the time of submission.
